searchText: Hey <@845691100072509460> <@412614104222531604> <@586161934425128960> <@358120958726373381> <@993802539856314398> and others, I've moved the "Cross Layer - inclusion lists" channel to the EIP-development category as `7805-focil` for consistency with other new EIPs. Just wanted to ping y'all to let you know it moved. let me know when you ready Why? We already talked about this before. 7805 was SFI'd as a headliner so it stayed there. `8141-frames` was created before it got SFI'd so if we really want consistency, we should move it to `Execution Layer` instead. IIRC the issue then was that we'd lose channel history. I thought we created a new channel instead of moving it. But I find it pretty difficult to find channels in this server. Putting all EIPs under development (current fork, next fork) in the same category with consistent naming will make this easier. No, it stayed there because of the reason I shared. cc <@731289513942450317> We can move it back, but I do really like the structure of this category. And I would prefer we go with this from now on. I'm sorry but it sounds arbitrary to me. Everyone might have different taste on the structure of EthR&D. I see the categories above like "post-quantum" and "el-networking" as themes, not specifically related to a particular EIP. Therefore I think it makes sense to group EIP development channels together. Only for serious EIPs of course. To be clear, I would support renaming/moving some other channels too, like `epbs` -> `7732-epbs` and `block-access-lists` to `7928-bals`. Then eventually put them in the channel graveyard, after the features ship on mainnet. Putting headliners in a separate category is confusing. nit: the new channel is under EIP-development which I need to scroll so far down. whereas inclusion-lists is under cross-layer which sits way higher. And I think focil/heze is important enough that it shouldn't be that far down Good point, I agree. We could move this entire category up, below "general" and above "testing". But we'll need to discuss this with other mods & agree to some form of consistent structure for EIP development channels going forward. Sorry for renaming this channel without discussing it here first; I didn't realize it would be so controversial. I shouldn't have just done it unilaterally. I was mistaken; this time is different from what had happened before. I'm open and happy to have a better structure. Thanks for taking the initiative!
